units.meaning: Except as provided in paragraph (a)(3)(iii)(B)( 4 ) of this action, an approved child restraint system consisting of seats manufactured to U.S. standards between January 1, 1981, and February 25, 1985, must bear the label: “This child restraint system conforms to all applicable Federal motor vehicle safety standards”.
